translations.web: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
translations.bsb: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.
translations.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
translations.asv: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
